Requirements: devkitPro with devkitA64, libnx, switch-tools, GNU make and Python 3.
On Windows, use the devkitPro MSYS2 shell. Keep the checkout path free of spaces.

Set DEVKITPRO to your devkitPro installation and DEVKITA64 to its devkitA64 folder.
Ensure devkitA64/bin and devkitPro/tools/bin are on PATH, then run:

    make -j4

The output is deploy/subsdk4 and deploy/main.npdm. Copy these into the mod's exefs
folder. This is the existing WiiXLaunch/exlaunch implementation for TOTK 1.2.1.
The complete local framework sources and generated settings are included; no
submodule download or proprietary game files are required to compile the module.
The game still needs the separately distributed mod assets to use the emotes.

Configuration goes in romfs/EmoteConfig/emotes.json and wheel.json. The module
creates sdcard/EmoteWheel/last-used.json for persistence.

Portability edits for this source release (2026-10-14): replaced local absolute
include paths in config.mk and fixed the make target name to stage in
misc/mk/common.mk. Gameplay and framework source files are unchanged.
